messages:
viv_devex: quick recap from the design review: thinking of an 'invoke summary' strip in playground run history that groups tool calls, shows a tiny 'schema snapshot' pill, and an inline diff chevron. compact so it fits narrow panes. reactions?

harper_design: like that. can you drop a tiny ascii so I can eyeball spacing on mobile? also microcopy ideas?

viv_devex: ascii:
[Assistant]
• [S] Translate.v2  · 3 calls · avg 40ms · p95 130ms · Schema used ›
• [U] ProfileSvc  · 1 call  · schema ok

leo_eng: engineering: show avg + p95, but allow expand to per-call list. lazy-load diffs for big runs. avoid rehydrating large diffs on list load.

matt_prod: preserve the schema snapshot per run (do not rewrite history). add a small CTA: "Re-run with latest schema" (opt-in).

iris_a11y: accessibility points: chips need 2rem touch target, visible focus ring, ARIA label like "invoke group: Translate.v2, 3 calls", and badges must have text + icon, not color only (contrast >= 4.5:1). keyboard: Tab into history, Arrow to chips, Enter expands, Esc closes. SR should announce "expanded schema diff, 3 changes".

bot-ci: test-check: add unit tests for 0/1/many tool-calls and extremely long tool ids; include keyboard nav E2E. CI will block missing tests. :robot_face:

viv_devex: captured actions: 1) invoke strip layout + structured/unstructured pill, 2) per-run snapshot + lazy diffs, 3) preserve expand state across paging, 4) keyboard/ARIA + contrast compliance, 5) reenact CTA, 6) collapse "+N more" for long lists, 7) tests for edge cases. will update proto and post screenshots. thanks!
